items: The constable's line now plays to the end: "ready for the VIP".
"Fifty over twen-" is gone; the flatline plays in silence but for the tone.
Lip sync: four more takes; the best (C5), with a slightly wider picture warp, has every mouth movement within 0.17 s of the words (C3 was 0.25 s out).
Filters: twelve to choose from on the picks page (round 9). The cut keeps bleach until you pick.
Lips good enough now? If not, the other route is to re-voice his line a touch faster to fit the mouth.
